name: rabi-workbuddy-context
description: Inject Rabi PC-managed context into WorkBuddy sessions and forward plan-bound turn completions through thin lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Use Rabi PC context in one WorkBuddy task.
interface.longDescription: Forward WorkBuddy session, prompt, tool-loop and Stop lifecycle events to Rabi PC Manager; inject bounded persona context and let Manager route plan-task completion reminders without duplicating Rabi management logic in the plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Bind this WorkBuddy task to my Rabi PC persona and report the Manager-owned context.
